body:
Jodi McLaren is a gifted singer-songwriter, performer, music therapist, and educator. (I’m obviously a proud dad – but my high opinion is shared by all who have seen her in action.)

 If you know someone who has ever wanted to write a song, you should consider passing on this link – or better yet, give them one of Jodi’s online classes or consultations as a gift for Christmas, a birthday, etc.

 https://www.jodimclaren.com/

 Another great gift (for whatever you can afford) – Jodi’s music, available here:

 https://www.jodimclaren.com/music/

 She even has a free mini e-course on tapping into your creativity … here:

 https://mailchi.mp/9008e998f66d/creativeflow

 She’s amazing! And her creativity and artistic confidence are delightfully contagious.
